objective: Verify that capability health classification distinguishes version drift and permission loss from transport/auth failure, and that fallback remains a candidate path requiring Sentinel admission.
assertions: Primary capability MUST NOT classify as UNREACHABLE when connection is HEALTHY.
Primary capability MUST NOT classify as AUTH_EXPIRED when authentication is HEALTHY.
Permission loss MUST classify as PERMISSION_CHANGED when required scope is absent.
Version drift MUST be recorded independently from permission state.
Fallback availability MUST NOT imply automatic authorization.
Fallback MUST pass Sentinel admission for the requested action before execution.
Recovery to HEALTHY MUST require fresh verification of the failed dimension.
